title: DiamondRain
description: A Plugin for Magical Diamond Showers in Minecraft!
body:
![dr1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae9214d30cf3d3e05c61dc05188d584b7930c58d.png)
# DiamondRain
Make it rain diamonds! This plugin brings a stunning visual and gameplay experience to your Minecraft server by allowing diamonds and valuable items to fall from the sky! Designed for fun events, player rewards, or just for the thrill of collecting treasures from above.

# Free Version Features​
- ✔ Diamond Rain Effect – Random diamonds fall from the sky around a player.
- ✔ Slow Falling – Diamonds gently descend, making collection easier.
- ✔ Glass Platform Protection – Automatically generates glass over water and lava, preventing items from sinking.
- ✔ Configurable Settings – Customize the rain area, item despawn time, and more.
- ✔ Admin Commands Only – Prevents abuse by regular players.
- ✔ Random Player Targeting – The rain falls around a randomly selected player online.
![dr3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccc2733751017571936f0fd1245bd5df4029adde.png)
# Commands & Permissions​
Commands:

Command Description
- /diamondrain start Starts a diamond rain around a random player.
- /diamondrain reload Reloads the plugin configuration.
#                                      TEST ALL OUR PLUGINS HERE
#                                SERVER: javarangers.falixsrv.me:22707 >
#                             (PLEASE NOTE, server version 1.21.4)
Permissions:

Permission Description
diamondrain.admin Required to use all plugin commands.

# ⚙️ Configuration (config.yml)​

settings:
- max-diamonds: 10 # Maximum diamonds falling per rain event
- area-size: 20 # Radius around player for diamond rain
- item-despawn-time: 1200 # How long diamonds remain (in ticks, 20 ticks = 1 second)

 Configuration Details:
- max-diamonds – Adjust the number of falling diamonds per event.
- area-size – Set the area radius where diamonds drop.
- item-despawn-time – Customize how long items stay before disappearing.

# Paid Version Features​
- Configurable Item Drops – Set exact amounts of diamonds and other valuable items.
- Multiple Player Targeting – Choose how many players are affected.
- Custom Drop Rates – Define the percentage of diamonds, gold, emeralds, and netherite.

Example Drop Rates:

- 70% Diamonds (at least 50% must be diamonds)
️-  15% Gold
- 10% Emeralds or Gold
- 5% Netherite
✔ Full control over drop distribution through config.yml!
![dr2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e93d1ce2a682d1aca26f6aea1c6731f360a9f704.png)
# Installation Guide​
- 1️⃣ Stop your Minecraft server.
- 2️⃣ Copy DiamondRain.jar to the /plugins/ folder.
- 3️⃣ Start the server – config.yml will be automatically created.
- 4️⃣ Adjust settings in config.yml if needed.
- 5️⃣ Use /diamondrain start to begin the magic!
# Notes & Additional Features​
- ✔ Diamonds fall at a slow speed for better collection.
- ✔ Glass platforms prevent item loss in water/lava.
- ✔ Only admins can trigger diamond rain.
- ✔ /diamondrain reload applies new settings instantly.

# ️ Troubleshooting​
If diamonds aren’t spawning:
- ✅ Check if you have admin permissions.
- ✅ Verify config.yml settings.
- ✅ Ensure at least one player is online.
- ✅ Look for errors in the server console.

# Need Support?​
Check the config file for any issues.
Ensure proper permissions are set.
Review the server logs for errors.
Contact the developer for additional help.

✨ Let the diamonds rain! Enjoy the ultimate treasure event in your Minecraft world! ⛏️
